name: Halsteren (Netherlands, 1976–1980)
description: A blue field with a yellow mounted Saint Martin cutting his cloak for a beggar standing at the fly.
history: Flag adopted by the municipality of Halsteren on 19 August 1976, showing Saint Martin from the municipal arms; it was replaced on 22 October 1980 by the flag used until the merger into Bergen op Zoom in 1997.

features.role: Saint Martin on horseback with a beggar
